assets.title: Framed Twin-Peak Contour Terrain Model
assets.description: One original static fictional desktop terrain model in a complete shallow closed-bottom frame. A single continuous closed terrain shell has an entire finite flat bottom on the frame floor, five visible height terraces, unequal west/east peaks, a broad connected saddle and front/rear valleys open to the lowland perimeter. Full finite vertical step walls and horizontal platforms are real material; there are no stacked hidden blocks, separate floating islands, image relief or reused natural cliff geometry. The frame has a 40 mm floor and a positive full-perimeter side clearance. Two closed meshes form one prop through one complete opposed finite bottom contact. Metres, native Z up, centred ground origin; six opaque unlinked constant Principled PBR colours assigned to whole contour levels. Existing map desk and map scroll already contain thin relief islands; this is a distinct newly authored multilevel connected terrain, not a claim that previous terrain was absent. Visual illustration only: no real geography, scale, navigation, geological or educational measurement accuracy, route planning, terrain editing, sand or water physics, load, material, manufacturing or safety performance. No table, legs, pins, flags, map scroll or full navigation scene.
